special_rules: No distinction between short-term and long-term in UK CGT
Business Asset Disposal Relief (BADR): 14% on qualifying business assets (lifetime limit £1m)
Bed & ISA strategy: sell and repurchase inside ISA to crystallise gains within annual exempt
HMRC treats crypto as a capital asset — CGT applies on disposal
Each crypto-to-crypto exchange is a disposal (taxable event)
Same-day rule and 30-day rule (bed & breakfasting) apply
Section 104 pool: average cost basis for matching rules
DeFi: staking income treated as miscellaneous income; LP activity may be complex
Mining/airdrops may be income — seek advice
crypto.filing_requirement: Self-Assessment SA100 and Capital Gains Summary SA108

special_rules: Private Residence Relief (PRR): full exemption on primary residence
Lettings relief abolished for most cases (except specific shared occupancy scenarios)
SDLT: Stamp Duty Land Tax on purchase (additional 3% surcharge for additional properties)
30-day reporting and payment requirement for UK residential property disposals
Non-resident CGT on UK property: UK property report required within 60 days
real_estate.filing_requirement: UK Property Return within 60 days of completion + Self-Assessment

notes: Rates apply to England, Wales, and Northern Ireland. Scotland has different income tax bands. Annual exempt amount reduced from £12,300 (2022) — plan accordingly.
